ai.validationFailed: Check the AI endpoint, model, permission profile, and numeric settings

engine.title: Default execution engine
engine.scope: This selection applies to the AI assistant, anime metadata inference, and filename inference.

builtIn.title: Built-in agent
builtIn.description: Call OpenAI, Anthropic, or a compatible HTTP model API directly.

codex.title: Local Codex app-server
codex.description: Send AI work over WebSocket to a Codex instance reachable by the server.

builtIn.title: Built-in model service
builtIn.description: Configure the active provider and default model. Switching providers does not delete the other provider's settings.

codex.title: Codex app-server connection
codex.description: This only connects to an app-server started by an administrator. It never starts processes or runs commands from the web UI.
codex.endpointError: Remote endpoints must use wss://; ws:// is allowed only for localhost or another loopback address.
codex.modelPlaceholder: Leave blank for the app-server default
codex.modelHelp: Optional. When blank, Codex app-server selects its default model.
codex.permissionProfileHelp: Required. Use :read-only or an administrator-defined profile. The backend verifies that the resolved sandbox is read-only and agent network access is disabled; the profile may still allow file reads.
codex.remoteTokenRequired: A bearer token is required for a remote wss:// endpoint.
codex.serverAddressHelp: The backend server connects to this address. In a container, 127.0.0.1 means the application container itself, not the host or this browser's device.

downloads.title: Downloads and storage
downloads.description: Configure the qBittorrent Web API connection. The download root affects existing physical paths and is not migrated from this page.
downloads.invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL
downloads.originCredentialRequired: The endpoint origin changed. Enter the password again or explicitly clear it.

qbittorrent.title: qBittorrent
qbittorrent.description: Submits, tracks, pauses, and cancels remote torrent jobs.

storage.title: Download storage root
storage.description: The storage path remains managed by deployment configuration.
storage.readOnlyHelp: Changing the download root affects active jobs, disk probes, and recorded physical paths, so use deployment configuration and a dedicated migration procedure.

media.validationFailed: Check the allowed roots and time formats

tmdb.title: TMDB metadata
tmdb.description: Provides normalized anime names, descriptions, posters, and season information.

allowedRoots.title: Allowed import roots
allowedRoots.description: Only directories below these absolute server paths can be added as media sources.

timing.title: Scanning and file stability

health.title: Health monitoring

health.validationFailed: Check the time, space, and percentage thresholds

download.title: Download incidents
download.description: Create an incident when progress stops, while limiting repeat reports.

reconciliation.title: Background reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Periodically checks inference, file mappings, downloads, and disk incidents.

disk.title: Disk space
disk.description: Available space must satisfy both the capacity and percentage thresholds.

access.title: Access protocols
access.description: Manage the read-only NFS export and independent WebDAV credentials for each device.
access.validationFailed: Check the NFS address, port, and numeric settings

nfs.title: Read-only NFSv4 export
nfs.description: Mount the same virtual filesystem over the network.
nfs.enabledHelp: The export is read-only; network and firewall configuration remain the security boundary.
nfs.restartHelp: NFS binds its listening port when the application starts. Changes are saved now and used after a restart.

mediaLibrary.title: Import an existing media library
mediaLibrary.intro: Scan media directories on the server and reuse the existing regular-expression, AI metadata inference, and virtual mapping pipeline to add their files to the library.

create.title: Add an import directory
create.pathHelp: Configure at least one MediaLibrary:AllowedRoots entry first. Enter an application-readable absolute server path under an allowed root, not a local path on this browser's device; it must not overlap the download directory managed by FileStore:Local. The first scan starts automatically.

safety.noMove: Import and later reconciliation only change media records and virtual path mappings in the database. Original files are never copied, moved, renamed, or deleted. Temporarily missing items lose their mapping first while watch and review history is retained for the configured grace period.
safety.containerMount: For container deployments, first mount the media directory read-only into the application container, then enter its absolute path inside the container here.

webdav.title: WebDAV credentials
webdav.intro: Issue per-device WebDAV username and access-token pairs. Tokens are stored as BCrypt hashes in the database and the plaintext is displayed exactly once at creation time. Revoke any pair at any time.

create.title: Create a new credential
create.usernameHelp: Usernames may contain letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' and must be 3-32 characters long.

created.title: Credential created
created.warning: Copy the access token now — you will not be able to view it again after leaving this page.

empty.title: No credentials yet
empty.body: Click Generate above to create a username and access token for a new device.

list.deleteConfirm: Revoke credential "{{username}}"? This cannot be undone.
